title: North Clubhouse Bazaar-  December 5, 2026
summary: Have stuff to sell? The North Rec Club is having a Bazaar Dec. 5th from 9am-1pm - rent a table for $20 to sell your goods. Contact Tom Sagitas at 727-315-4369 (home #) to book your table. And if you have Christmas Decorations you would like to get rid of we are taking donations for the clubhouse to sell at the Bazaar. Contact Tom and he will pick it up for you. Thank you!
